easier to interpret. I am confused because I cannot seem to get the

parts:
Hi,
In the future, taking the time to make a simpler example will likely
result in more (and faster) responses. That said, I took some time to
look through your code and came to the following conclusions

1) Your approach will work provided that you create colours as a named
vector. That is, you defined colours as

when you should have defined it as

colours = c("Control-Region" = "lightblue4", "tRNA" = "magenta4",
"rRNA" = "mediumaquamarine", "Non-Coding" = "sienna4", "ND1" =
"magenta", "ND2" = "mediumblue", "CO1" = "olivedrab", "CO2" =
"orange2", "ATP8" = "orchid4", "ATP6" = "red3", "CO3" =
"royalblue2", "ND3" = "palegreen4", "ND4L" = "grey0", "ND4" =
"pink4", "ND5" = "yellow4", "ND6" = "steelblue4", "CYB" =
"tan","red")

2) You are working too hard. You can achieve the same result by
changing gene to a factor (in both lines and mitodata) and getting rid
of the scale_colour_manual part (you also need to set the constant
line colors outside of the aes() calls to prevent them from inclusion
in the legend).

Best,
Ista
